predecessor.why_separate_identity: Original design assigned execution to another authority; this FORGE-native study has a new role/seed namespace and cannot silently amend original preregistration

question: In two fixed source-free causal systems, can equally FIT-trained public-history models predict next public sensor bits more efficiently than fully FIT-trained controls conditioned on current observations and the same public action window, while maintaining a zero-signal null?

hypothesis_alternatives.H1: Both causal families exceed the frozen empirical gain and episode-bootstrap confidence thresholds under matched public FIT inputs
hypothesis_alternatives.H0: At least one causal family fails the gains or confidence limits or the null gives spurious history advantage

generator.action_policy: Each a_t sampled from independent Bernoulli(1/2); identical public action-observation trajectories to every comparator; no learned action policy
generator.public_information: At prediction time t only observations o_0..o_t and public actions a_0..a_t; current baselines receive o_t, a_t, a_(t-1); no future outcomes, hidden sensor slot or private state

training.checkpoint_selection: minimum FIT_VALID NLL separately among current and history models

development_decision.metric: mean next public Bernoulli negative log likelihood in nats per bit

admission.required_before_any_role_episode: Independently deployed and authenticated FORGE scientific owner with immutable source/protocol, first-use journal and native worker lease; self-authored CI or this protocol is not an admission

guardrails: Never amend the original predecessor preregistration or rewrite negative results
Never instantiate reserved Q20 or original Q21 protected cohorts
No generation of Q21N-01 FIT_TRAIN, FIT_VALID or DEV before authentic FORGE FSA admission
Test or workflow invocations on this branch may inspect bytes and synthetic hand-written fixtures only
No new controller, scheduler, signing authority, cross-project token, broker action, paid API or protected dataset access
No threshold revision after first cohort birth; release a separate prospectively versioned study for substantive changes
All failed, negative or ambiguous starts and cross-platform outcomes preserved; no silent positive result
No automatic claim of ITD-01 transferable cognition from one-step predictive success
